{{Quote|Ross Mysliwiec: to protect and serve the universe as a noble Jedi|Statue plaque|<ref name="SWB" />}}
'''Ross Mysliwiec''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] long before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:RossPlaque.png|thumb|left|Close-up of Mysliwiec's plaque, revealing his name]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Ross Mysliwiec was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. While his deeds were lost to history, a stone statue was erected in his memory in the keep of a [[Rhen Var Citadel|citadel]] on the planet [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]].<ref name="SWB" /> The statue and the citadel itself survived until the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. A battle between the two sides during the [[Battle of Rhen Var (Clone Wars)|Battle of Rhen Var]] left the citadel in ruins,<ref name="SWB" /> but a plaque identifying the statue as depicting Mysliwiec was still legible above the statue.<ref name="SWB" /> Inside the citadel was also a tomb, possibly belonging to this ancient Jedi.<ref name="SWB" /> Mysliwiec's name appeared on a building several kilometers to the east in an old, frozen harbor.<ref name="SWB" />
